Store_Product_Description_0:
Adds one extra plant card slot.

When you see the first Pole Vaulting Zombie on wave 5, the thought in your head isn't ‘what should I plant?’ — it's ‘why did I only bring 6 slots?’ That question haunted us for years, until we decided to open up extra card slots to the public. Now you can bring 7, 8, even 10. But honestly, if you can't figure out 6, 10 will only confuse you more. Still, paying is your right. We just collect the money.
Store_Product_Description_1:
Unlocks the Incense Burner plant card.

This incense burner took eighteen months to develop. We tested seventeen copper alloys, nine coating processes and four base heights. In the end we found that their effect on the ‘chance of divine manifestation’ was exactly zero. We still priced it at $5,000. People who can afford it won't ask why, and people who can't afford it gain nothing by asking.
Store_Product_Description_2:
Unlocks the Meat Grinder plant card.

Our sales team's favorite line: it can't grind metal, it can't grind stone, and it can't grind faith. Other than that, it's not a picky eater.
PeaShooter_Description:
<color=#11037A>Peashooter is your first line of defense. It attacks zombies by firing peas.</color>

How can a single plant grow and shoot so many peas so quickly? Peashooter says, “Hard work, commitment, and a healthy, well-balanced breakfast of sunlight and high-fiber carbon dioxide make it all possible.”
SunFlower_Description:
<color=#11037A>Sunflower produces extra sun. Try to plant as many as possible!</color>

Sunflower can't resist bouncing to the beat. Which beat is that? Why, the life-giving jazzy rhythm of the Earth itself, thumping at a frequency only Sunflower can hear.
CherryBomb_Description:
<color=#11037A>Cherry Bomb blows up all zombies in an area.</color>

“I wanna explode,” says Cherry #1. “No, let's detonate instead!” says his brother, Cherry #2. After intense consultation they agree to explodonate.
Wallnut_Description:
<color=#11037A>Wall-nut has a tough shell that protects your other plants.</color>

“People wonder how I feel about getting constantly chewed on by zombies,” says Wall-nut. “What they don't realize is that with my limited senses all I can feel is a kind of tingling, like a relaxing back rub.”
PotatoMine_Description:
<color=#11037A>Potato Mine takes time to arm, but deals massive damage to the zombie that steps on it.</color>

Some folks say Potato Mine is lazy, that he leaves everything to the last minute. Potato Mine says nothing. He's too busy thinking about his investment strategy.
SnowPea_Description:
<color=#11037A>Snow Pea fires frozen peas that slow zombies.</color>

Folks often tell Snow Pea how “cool” he is, or tell him to “chill out” and “stay frosty.” Snow Pea just rolls his eyes. He's heard 'em all.
Chomper_Description:
<color=#11037A>Chomper can swallow most zombies whole, but needs time to digest.</color>

Chomper almost got a gig doing stunts for “Little Shop of Horrors”, but it fell through when his agent demanded too much on the front end. Chomper's not resentful, though. He says it's just part of the business.
MutatedChomper_Description:
<color=#11037A>Mutated Chomper can hold up to two zombies. The first takes 30 seconds to digest and the second adds 15 seconds. When digestion ends, it fires one zombie skull for each zombie eaten.</color>

Mutated Chomper used to be the pickiest eater in the Chomper family. To cure him of it, his family followed a wise man's advice and sent him to study abroad for a while. Now his family has a new worry: he seems a little too eager to eat anything.
BloodPeaShooter_Description:
<color=#11037A>A shooter that was already infected when its seed packet was delivered. It fires worm-eaten peas that deal extra rot damage.</color>

Blood Peashooter's looks make every plant and zombie keep their distance. Even it doesn't know why it turned out like this — the only one who might is the breeder who mistook red paint for pesticide.
BloodSunFlower_Description:
<color=#11037A>Produces sun. When planted behind another plant, it assimilates the plant in front of it.</color>

Blood Sunflower's Halloween look won first prize at the Plant Horror Expo and inspired countless copycat fans. “I don't actually wear makeup, so stop asking how I do it. My job is making sun, not being compared to those damn zombies,” she often complains. After she got famous, Dave hired her as his garden stylist, but she seems to know only one look. “I'm very sorry, sir, I never said I could do styling,” she said, facing a stunned Dave.
SarcomaWallnut_Description:
<color=#11037A>Sarcoma Wall-nut has 4000 body health. While being eaten, every 500 health lost releases poison mist; on death it bursts and applies 5 poison stacks to zombies in a 3x3 area.</color>

Sarcoma Wall-nut is very relaxed about expiration dates. “The package says three days,” he says, “but I've been standing here for three months.” Every zombie that bites him complains that he tastes wrong, but he isn't worried — so far, not a single one has come back for a refund.
Tallnut_Description:
<color=#11037A>Tall-nut is taller and harder to get over than a regular Wall-nut.</color>

People wonder if there's a rivalry between Wall-nut and Tall-nut. Tall-nut laughs a rich, baritone laugh. “How could there be anything between us? We are brothers. If you knew what Wall-nut has done for me...” Tall-nut's voice trails off and he smiles knowingly.
VisceraMine_Description:
<color=#11037A>After it explodes, Viscera Mine rolls out a ball of guts that bowls through every enemy in a straight line.</color>

Most of the eerie plants refuse to admit Viscera Mine is one of them, since it doesn't even look like a plant anymore. “Actually...” says Viscera Mine, “I used to be tofu pudding...”
MeatGrinder_Description:
<color=#11037A>Meat Grinder pulls the zombie in front of it into its body and grinds out flesh cubes. Flesh cubes lure zombies from other rows.</color>

Every plant is curious about what's inside Meat Grinder. Nobody except its creator knows that it's really just a Chomper with indigestion.
VisceraBomb_Description:
<color=#11037A>Deals 1800 damage in a 3×3 area and sprays a ring of guts that damage the enemies they hit.</color>

The plants all have complaints about Viscera Bomb, because whenever it gets emotional, it splatters ‘filth’ all over them. Nobody likes being near it. Only Viscera Bomb knows the truth: it isn't emotional, it just has bad digestion. And that ‘filth’ is only half-digested leftovers.
TwinSunflower_Description:
<color=#11037A>Twin Sunflower produces twice as much sun as a regular Sunflower.</color>

It was a crazed night of forbidden science that brought Twin Sunflower into existence. Thunder crashed overhead and the very wind seemed to roar its angry denial. But to no avail. Twin Sunflower was alive, ALIVE!
SuperMachineGunShooter_Description:
<color=#11037A>Fires 4 peas per attack and has a 5% chance to go full auto, unleashing 180 peas across a 30-degree cone in about 2.1 seconds.</color>

Super Gatling Peashooter insists he isn't showing off. “Four at a time is just basic manners,” he says. “Throwing in an extra 176 now and then — that's real hospitality.” The neighbors once asked him to keep the noise down, so he nodded seriously and put on a pair of earplugs.
SuperMagicShooter_Description:
<color=#11037A>Fires 4 magic peas dealing 40 damage each and has a 5% chance to go full auto, unleashing 180 magic peas across a 30-degree cone in about 2.1 seconds.</color>

Super Magic Gatling Peashooter doesn't like people saying he's gone mad with magic. “I just swapped regular firepower for magic firepower,” he says, “and got a pointier hat while I was at it.” As for where those 180 peas are hidden, he refuses to answer, saying only that magazine capacity is a trade secret.
DoublePeaShooter_Description:
<color=#11037A>Repeater fires two peas at a time.</color>

Repeater is fierce. He's from the streets. He doesn't take attitude from anybody, plant or zombie, and he shoots peas to keep people at a distance. Secretly, though, Repeater yearns for love.
Squash_Description:
<color=#11037A>Squash crushes the first zombie that gets close to it.</color>

“I'm ready!” yells Squash. “Do it! Put me in! There's nobody better! I'm your guy! C'mon! Whaddya waiting for? I need this!”
BloodSquash_Description:
<color=#11037A>Blood Squash crushes its target, then slams down 5 more times, dealing Squash damage on each slam.</color>

Although he looks like he just escaped from a horror movie set, Blood Squash is actually a softie. They say his bone-chilling grin came from practicing how to look ‘fiercer’ to scare off zombies — and he overdid it. He doesn't like frightening children, but his bloodshot eyes and jagged teeth always make zombies think he's some kind of mutant man-eating plant.
Xuefo_Description:
<color=#11037A>Blood Buddha draws attacks from both sides. When damaged by a zombie, it randomly locks onto a damageable zombie and reflects double the actual damage to it; when the locked target dies, a new zombie is locked at random. When hit by plant bullets, it lights up and passes double damage to the nearest plant.</color>

Wow, someone forgot to turn off friendly fire.
Stove_Description:
<color=#11037A>The Incense Burner has no body and can only be planted onto an existing plant. On Blood Buddha, it grants a 20-second golden state in which plant attacks on the Buddha also redirect double damage to the locked random zombie. On other plants, it triggers a 400-damage explosion on that tile.</color>

Offering incense is one of the finest delicacies in the eerie world, said to be ‘so fragrant you'll lose your head’ — and for plants with sharper noses, ‘so fragrant it explodes’. Even Blood Buddha can't resist: “Excellent. This incense clears the mind and lifts the spirit, as if pure energy rushes to the crown.” The recipe has long been top secret; only the truckloads of firecrackers delivered to the incense factory hint at its forbidden nature.
HypothermiaPeaShooter_Description:
<color=#11037A>Shoots ice peas that chill enemies. Each hit stacks 20% chill; at 100% the zombie is frozen permanently, and any further hit kills it instantly.</color>

The plants all wonder why Freeze Pea Shooter keeps swinging its head, but it never explains. It used to think it was never cold enough. Eventually it succeeded — and now it's so cold that even its neck is frozen stiff.
Lin_Cornpult_Description:
<color=#11037A>Throws a talisman every 3 seconds. Yellow talismans immobilize zombies and purple talismans deal extreme damage. At close range it attacks zombies in an area with a peach-wood sword.</color>

“I'll do my best to hold off these eerie things,” Taoist Kernel-pult wrote in his report to the company. “Including the ones in the house behind me.”
Wawa_Description:
<color=#11037A>The Voodoo Doll draws attacks from both sides. When it dies (except by shovel), it teleports to the nearest zombie, casts a curse, and dies together with it.</color>

For a long time the plants have wondered how the Voodoo Doll kills zombies without a trace. Some think it learned black magic deep in the mountains; others think it was born with special powers. But according to the doll itself, it just stuffed nearly every serious allergen on the market into its body.
Pudding_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pudding reflects flying bullets that hit it. When zombies get close, it spends 100 health to knock all nearby zombies back one tile.</color>

Pudding is a true gymnast — as long as there's no time limit. “If someone could pull me off after every routine, I'd do even better,” Pudding says from the balance beam. “Otherwise I have to wait for this stupid beam to snap before I can go collect my medal.”
GlutinousRice_Description:
<color=#11037A>Sticky Rice-pult lobs sticky rice every 3 seconds. When it hits a zombie, it also creates a Rice Pool on that zombie's tile that lasts 5 seconds.</color>

Sticky Rice-pult comes from an ancient, mysterious Eastern family whose trade for generations has been ‘exorcising evil and pinning down corpses’. She claims she once subdued an evil a hundred times worse than Cthulhu — though she calls it ‘overtime’ and refuses to say more. Her sticky rice is super effective against all ‘unclean things’, but for some reason, whenever she sees a Disco Zombie she pulls out her phone and asks for a selfie.
TaoistGlutinousRice_Description:
<color=#11037A>Every 2.5 seconds, Taoist Sticky Rice-pult throws a sticky rice ball at the closest zombie ahead in its own row and the rows above and below, immobilizing it before a delayed blast.</color>

Sun:<color=#FF0000>250</color>
Cooldown:<color=#FF0000>50s</color>

The Taoist Sticky Rice-pult isn't actually good at Taoist magic. When anyone asks the secret of her efficient exorcisms, she just points at her robe. In truth she was just one of many Sticky Rice-pults — until one day, while watching a Doom-shroom, she had a brilliant idea and put explosives in her rice.
ExperimentFlower_Description: <color=#11037A>Produces sun normally. When a zombie comes within three tiles, it charges for 5 seconds and creates a brain bullet. It can create at most one every 20 seconds.</color>
Madnut_Description: <color=#11037A>Caged Wall-nut has 4000 health. When its health drops below 2000, it goes mad and attacks nearby zombies for 20 damage per hit.</color>
BloodCaltrop_Description:
<color=#11037A>Zombies do not attack Blood Caltrop. While zombies stand on it, it deals 25 area damage every 1.5 seconds and applies one Bleed stack. If a zombie dies on it, Blood appears on the empty tile ahead; if a zombie dies on Blood, the Blood becomes a new Blood Caltrop.</color>

Blood Caltrop always felt it didn't fit in: “Am I a plant, or an eerie thing?” It fights side by side with the plants and spreads across the lawn like a weed, yet it contains no plant matter at all — its mind and its body just don't agree. These deep thoughts went on until the day before yesterday. No, it didn't figure it out. It was taken away by the Family Planning Committee for having too many offspring.
AlienShooter_Description:
<color=#11037A>Alien Shooter fires peas at targets ahead. Every 5 seconds, it pulls Blood Sun on the lawn toward itself; each absorbed Blood Sun raises its form by one level, up to level 2.</color>

Blood Peashooter often envies Alien Shooter's unique hairstyle. Alien Shooter just smiles and says nothing. Only it knows that those curls blocking its view are just a mop head that got permed by a Cherry Bomb blast.
Thorns_Description:
<color=#11037A>Bloodstained Thorns has 500 health and can share a tile with one non-spike plant. A shooter sharing its tile attacks 50% faster, but the plant inside loses 5 health every 1.5 seconds. Zombies that bite the Thorns take equal damage back.</color>

Bloodstained Thorns is an excellent massage therapist. He cured Freeze Pea Shooter of procrastination. When the plants asked how, he said: “My thorns made him a bit more... prickly about getting things done.”
IronMaiden_Description:
<color=#11037A>Iron Maiden has 8000 health. It opens its doors to let in one zombie of a type Meat Grinder can swallow, then shuts and devours it. After 30 seconds it opens again and drains the zombie out as blood. Produces one Blood Sun every 6 seconds.</color>

Do you know why Iron Maiden produces sun? Because it's the Queen of Stabbing... and sun-bathing.
PastorGarlic_Description:
<color=#11037A>Gains one cross every 25 seconds. Each time it gains a cross, it heals allied plants in the surrounding 3×3 area for 100 health. With fewer than 3 crosses, click it to spend 150 sun and gain one immediately; with 3 crosses, click it to summon a Paladin Gargantuar. After summoning, it turns gray and loses its abilities for 30 seconds.</color>

All that is taken shall be repaid! All that is lost shall return!
ScripturePumpkin_Description:
<color=#11037A>Merciful Pumpkin has 4000 health and halves all damage it takes. The plant in its tile is immune to sunflower infection, Paperman's instant kill, and explosion damage. Its immunity animation plays whenever the protection triggers. Covering a Blood Sunflower removes its infection ability. Merciful Pumpkin cannot be crushed by the Tall Zombie.</color>

Will you let go, and let me guide you to rebirth...
Zombie_Normal_Description:
<color=#11037A>Regular Zombie.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 (base)</color>

This zombie loves brains. Can't get enough. Brains, brains, brains, day in and day out. Old and stinky brains? Rotten brains? Doesn't matter. Zombies don't mind.
Zombie_cone_Description:
<color=#11037A>Conehead Zombie wears a traffic cone and can take more punishment.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base, cone armor</color>

He shambled mindlessly forward like any other zombie. But something made him stop, made him pick up a traffic cone and stick it on his head. Oh yeah. He likes to party.
Zombie_bucket_Description:
<color=#11037A>Buckethead Zombie wears a metal bucket for stronger protection.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base, bucket armor</color>

Buckethead Zombie always wore a bucket. Part of it was to assert his uniqueness in an uncaring world. Mostly he just forgot it was there in the first place.
Zombie_Polevaulter_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pole Vaulting Zombie moves quickly and jumps over the first plant it reaches.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>500 base</color>

Some zombies take it further, aspire more, push themselves beyond the normal into greatness. That's Pole Vaulting Zombie.
Maggot_Description:
<color=#11037A>Maggot does not lose its arms or head and has no dying stage.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

Although the maggot was never infected by the eerie, it still loves crawling around in the dark. Not because it's small, but because it worships ‘Voldemort’ — the Dark Lord who lies low. Of course, to everyone else, it's just a maggot.
Zombie_Maggot_Description:
<color=#11037A>Maggot Zombie does not lose its arms or head and has no dying threshold. It creates 1 Maggot every 10 seconds and 3 Maggots on death.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

Maggot Zombie used to be an ordinary, slightly sloppy office worker. He didn't like showering, didn't change his clothes, and his desk was always piled with takeout boxes. His coworkers' nickname for him went from ‘Stinky’ all the way up to ‘Mobile Garbage Dump’, and he never cared. Then one day Paperman tried to make him a new set of paper clothes as a gift, but was driven back by his green fumes the moment she got close. “You could make paper grow a patina!” she complained. Maggot Zombie scratched his head: “How about... I take a shower first and then change?” Paperman was shocked: “You actually shower?!” He answered seriously: “I did once, three years ago.” After a long silence, Paperman pushed the clothes into his hands: “Keep them. I'll make another set.” Later even Dr. Zomboss couldn't help asking him: “Could you at least wash your face before reporting for duty?” He thought hard for a full three seconds, then said: “But what about all the little ones living on me? I promised to raise them.” The doctor never brought up hygiene again. Friendly reminder: when he bursts, his ‘little ones’ will carry out his last wish — crawling into every corner of your lawn.
Paperman_Description:
<color=#11037A>Paperman does not move or eat. It attaches itself next to a plant, revives after its first death, and summons another of its kind.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>300 base</color>

Paperman came from a century-old funeral supply shop and was reportedly picked on sight for her ‘exquisite craftsmanship’. The eerie ones wanted her to make dummy targets for the logistics corps, but she insisted on the front line: “I've been making paper people for years — time to make some real ones!” she said proudly. Her fighting power is questionable, though; a paper fist hitting someone counts as ‘physical discouragement’ at best. The real trouble is that when she catches fire, she becomes an out-of-control fireball dancing on your lawn — destroying the enemy with the enemy's own methods. That is her final philosophy.
Pseudoman1_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pseudoman 1. Plant attacks cannot hit it until its disguise breaks. It attacks both plants and zombies, and its disguise is gone for good after its first attack.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

Pseudoman is a character actor poached from ‘the set next door’. He played ‘kind passer-by’ in many city dramas, and his unique talent for ‘looking exactly like a zombie’ earned him lots of praise. His disguise is so perfect that even the plants don't know where to shoot — after all, who would attack a guy in a brown coat who looks like he's rushing to catch the subway? But the moment he attacks, his overly professional ‘zombie roar’ gives him away. Friendly reminder: the coffee he's drinking is a prop. Don't try it.
Pseudoman2_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pseudoman 2. Plant attacks cannot hit it until its disguise breaks. It attacks both plants and zombies, and its disguise is gone for good after its first attack.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

This Pseudoman often tries to disguise himself as a human and invites other zombies to do the same. He firmly believes that if he pretends to be human long enough, he'll grow a brain of his own. Clearly, after all this time, he still hasn't grown a single tasty brain.
Pseudoman3_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pseudoman 3. Its animation is mirrored, but it moves normally. Plant attacks cannot hit it until its disguise breaks. It attacks both plants and zombies, and its disguise is gone for good after its first attack.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

The eerie ones always mock Pseudoman as a clumsy imitator who can only walk backwards. Pseudoman always replies that he's cosplaying the Dancing Zombie and doing the moonwalk.
Pseudoman4_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pseudoman 4. Its animation is mirrored, but it moves normally. Plant attacks cannot hit it until its disguise breaks. It attacks both plants and zombies, and its disguise is gone for good after its first attack.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

Since birth, Pseudoman has never had any kind of legal identity. All the zombies hate him — at 21 he wasn't even allowed a traffic cone as his coming-of-age gift. “They hate me because my imitation is too good,” says Pseudoman.
Pseudoman5_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pseudoman 5. Its animation is upside down. Plant attacks cannot hit it until its disguise breaks. It attacks both plants and zombies, and its disguise is gone for good after its first attack.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

This Pseudoman is really just a Dancing Zombie fan who loves masquerade balls. Nobody knows how he manages to walk while standing on his head — and nobody knows it's just his attempt to stop getting his head knocked off.
Pseudoman6_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pseudoman 6. Its animation is upside down. Plant attacks cannot hit it until its disguise breaks. It attacks both plants and zombies, and its disguise is gone for good after its first attack.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

Someone once asked Pseudoman why he wears a suit with no tie. The answer is always: “It makes me feel like I'm suffocating.” But he doesn't even need to breathe — he just can't afford one. Paperman has also seen him sneaking off at midnight to a rehab group, which explains why he sometimes stands on his head: Paperman guesses he lost a bet.
SoulStirring_Description:
<color=#11037A>Soul Stirring Zombie walks forward and releases one shockwave when it reaches the 9th tile or meets a plant earlier. The shockwave terrifies and silences the plants in front of it for 20 seconds, except Meat Grinder.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>
Pilgrim_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pilgrim wears cone armor. While the armor lasts, it loses 20 armor health every 3 seconds. Otherwise it behaves like a regular zombie.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base, cone armor 370</color>

Pilgrim's path of faith began with an impulse purchase. On closing night at the British Museum, he took a liking to a ‘handmade vintage headpiece with spikes’ and thought ‘I'd look so classy in this’ — so he walked off with it. The problem is that every spike on this crown keeps reminding him that stealing has a price. Every three steps he gets pricked and grimaces in pain, but he still won't take it off, because he believes that if he walks fast enough, the pain can't catch up. Unfortunately, the pain turned out to be far more persistent than he imagined.
Executor_Description:
<color=#11037A>After killing a plant, Executioner turns around and walks to the edge of the map, then comes back. On the way back it still attacks plants in its path, and if it kills another plant, it turns around again immediately.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base, bucket armor 1100</color>

Executioner used to be an ordinary, law-abiding zombie lumberjack. Then one sunny afternoon, a squad of police put a sack over his head and took him away over an illegal logging case. Halfway there, the radio crackled: ‘Wrong guy. His neighbor cut that tree. Let him go.’ So they tossed him straight out of the speeding police car — sack still on, axe still in hand. He rolled three and a half times, stood up, and his first thought was: ‘Was I just cutting a tree? Where was that tree? I need to go back and finish it.’ Sadly, the holes in the sack are too small; he can't tell trees from plants, or even where he's going. So he picked up a habit: chop down everything in front of him that looks like firewood, then walk back to check whether he got the right one — and if not, keep searching.
Zombie_scarecrow_Description:
<color=#11037A>Scarecrow Zombie stops when it reaches a set column. When it takes a large single hit, it releases a crow.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>1100 base</color>

Scarecrow Zombie often forgets why he's dressed up as a zombie. The crows told him it's to scare off people who sneak into the rice field to steal grain. So whenever he sees someone walk in carrying a sickle, he howls with all his might to prove he's doing his job. Yet for some reason, every time, someone whips him.
Crow_Description:
<color=#11037A>Crows are released by Scarecrow Zombies and quickly peck at plants.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>135 base</color>
Attack:<color=#FF0000>25</color>

Crows aren't born monsters — they're the Scarecrow Zombie's ‘loyal fans’. Before he was stuck on that cross, the Scarecrow Zombie was supposedly an amateur ornithologist who ‘won over’ a flock of crows in his own way: ‘Follow me, and you'll have endless...’ He never finished the sentence, but the crows clearly got the message. Now they're the most annoying flash mob on the lawn — they won't fight you head-on, but the moment you look away, they'll peck your new plants into works of art. Friendly reminder: they especially love Sunflowers, because ‘that thing looks like chocolate’.
HangedCorpse_Description:
<color=#11037A>Hanged Corpse prefers to drop in front of a tile with a plant, pins that tile, and silences the plant in it.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

In life, Hanged Corpse was chief bridge designer in Dr. Zomboss's engineering department. During a meeting about ‘crossing the moat’, he suggested ‘solving the problem with rope’ and was let go on the spot — literally. Now he continues his career in another form, dedicated to helping your plants ‘save floor space’. Witnesses say he often mutters as he passes by: ‘This height works... this height really works...’
CarPaperman_Description:
<color=#11037A>Paper Sedan Zombie appears after enough Papermen have died. It runs over everything in its path and summons the Ghost Bride.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>3000 base</color>

These four paper men are star employees of the underworld's ‘Fastest Courier Company’, specializing in ‘Afterlife Express’ — but their navigation system only seems to recognize lawns in the world of the living. Whenever enough Papermen ‘clock out early’, they get called in as replacements. Their work ethic is incredible: no matter what they run over, they never break formation. As for who's sitting in the sedan chair... better not ask. They say the last Football Zombie who tried to lift the curtain is now head cheerleader down in the underworld.
Bride_Description:
<color=#11037A>Ghost Bride is summoned by the Paper Sedan Zombie. She blinks around and throws handkerchiefs at plants in her row.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>1800 base</color>

Legend says she was the daughter of a wealthy family who was left in the bridal sedan when the groom ran away on their wedding day — and then she waited a full hundred years. Now she has finally found a new ‘groom’ on the battlefield. Unfortunately her standards are rather broad: ‘Anyone alive will do.’ She is obsessively possessive of whoever is in the house, and anything standing in her way gets a red handkerchief floated over to it — after which it turns to dust. As for zombies? She says: ‘A bit ugly, but at least they're honest.’
Taller_Description:
<color=#11037A>Tall Zombie can only be hit by explosions, area damage and lobbed projectiles. It never stops to attack plants; it flattens the plants under its feet as it walks, and when it dies, it falls forward and flattens the area in front of it.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>1800 base</color>

“When are the eerie ones holding their own Olympics?”
Qitao_Description:
<color=#11037A>Beggar only appears on rows with plants. He runs to the first plant and begs; click him within 5 seconds and pay 100 coins to make him leave. If you don't pay, he carries the plant off the lawn. He does not attack and cannot be damaged.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>Invincible</color>
Survivor_Zombie_Description:
<color=#11037A>Survivor Zombie fights for the plants and only attacks enemy zombies. It plays an entrance animation when it appears.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base</color>

Survivor Zombie was once just an ordinary actor with an ordinary career — until the open casting for the movie ‘Eerie Invasion’ made him an overnight star. “If you ask me the secret to success, I'll tell you luck and good looks are part of talent too!”
C2Zombie_Description:
<color=#11037A>C2 Zombie can only be killed by ash damage. Every 500 damage it takes grows another head; with 4 heads it crawls forward and crushes plants, and with 5 heads it stops in place.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>Invincible</color>

With one head, it's a standard, obedient zombie. When it grows a second head, minor disagreements begin — ‘Go left?’ ‘No, right.’ By five heads, the whole lawn can hear their heated debate over ‘eat the plants first or cross the road first’. Meanwhile the original body — the first and most honest head — is worn out trying to keep the peace: ‘Stop fighting, everyone! Can we at least agree on a direction before we argue?!’
Siren_Description:
<color=#11037A>Siren Head sounds its siren as soon as it reaches column 9. While sounding, it stays in place for 25 seconds and calls 3 zombie waves, 3 seconds apart, each spawning one Regular Zombie or Pilgrim per row. It sounds the siren again 10 seconds after it finishes waiting. When it reaches a plant, it grabs the plant and eats it whole.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>1100 base</color>

Siren Head was once a Cold War air-raid siren. After retiring, he joined the eerie ones as ‘Head of Battlefield Atmosphere’. But everyone soon realized his true talent isn't making fear — it's making noise. Every morning he blasts out ‘O Sole Mio’ on his siren, supposedly learned from the loudspeaker at the construction site next door. The neighbors (the other eerie ones) have strong opinions about it, but nobody dares say so to his face, because that would mean listening to him siren-howl an entire Tibetan Plateau ballad. When he finally reaches the middle of the lawn, his ‘performance’ hits its climax — a 25-second improvised singing spree that brings every ‘audience member’ for miles around to the show. Friendly reminder: bring earplugs. If you still have ears.
Terrorist1_Description:
<color=#11037A>Terrorist 1 normally chops plants with an axe. If a Terrorist 2 in the same row is controlling the sickle, he runs in front of it, becomes untargetable, and instantly kills nearby plants. When Terrorist 1 dies, his bound Terrorist 2 dies too.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>400 base</color>
Terrorist2_Description:
<color=#11037A>Terrorist 2 does not attack plants. At the 8th tile he crouches and controls a sickle. The sickle starts at the first tile, advances one tile every 5 seconds, and pushes any continuous line of plants along with it.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>1000 base</color>
PauseMenu_MainMenu_Content: Do you want to return to the main menu?
PauseMenu_Restart_Content: Do you want to retry this level?
Money_Not_Enough_Tip: You don't have enough coins. Purchase failed.
PuffShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Puff-shrooms are free, but short-ranged.</color>

“I only recently got to know about these zombie things,” says Puff-shroom. “Like a lot of fungi, I'd just kind of assumed they were fairy tales or movie monsters. This whole thing's been a huge eye-opener for me.”
SunShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Sun-shrooms give small sun at first and normal sun later.</color>

Sun-shroom hates sun. He hates it so much that when it builds up inside him, he spits it out as fast as he can. He just won't abide it. To him, sun is foul.
FumeShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Fume-shroom shoots fumes that can pass through screen doors.</color>

“I was in a dead-end job producing yeast spores for a bakery,” says Fume-shroom. “Then Puff-shroom, bless 'im, told me about this great opportunity blasting zombies. Now I really feel like I'm making a difference.”
GraveBuster_Description:
<color=#11037A>Grave Buster eats graves.</color>

Despite Grave Buster's fearsome appearance, he wants everyone to know that he loves kittens and spends his off hours volunteering at a local zombie rehabilitation center. “It's just the right thing to do,” he says.
HypnoShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>When eaten, Hypno-shroom makes a zombie turn around and fight for you.</color>

“Zombies are our friends,” asserts Hypno-shroom. “They're badly misunderstood creatures who play a valuable role in our ecology. We can and should do more to bring them round to our way of thinking.”
ScaredyShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Scaredy-shroom is a long-ranged shooter that hides when enemies get near it.</color>

“Who's there?” whispers Scaredy-shroom, voice barely audible. “Go away. I don't want to see anybody. Unless... unless it's the man from the circus.”
IceShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Ice-shroom temporarily freezes all zombies on the screen.</color>

Ice-shroom frowns, not because he's unhappy or because he disapproves, but because of a childhood injury that left his face paralyzed.
DoomShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Doom-shroom destroys zombies in a large area, leaving a crater that can't be planted on.</color>

“You're lucky I'm on your side,” says Doom-shroom. “I could destroy everything you hold dear. Wouldn't be hard.”
LilyPad_Description:
<color=#11037A>Lily Pad lets you plant non-aquatic plants on top of it.</color>

Lily Pad never complains. Lily Pad never wants to know what's going on. Put a plant on top of Lily Pad, he won't say a thing. Does he have startling opinions or shocking secrets? Nobody knows. Lily Pad keeps it all inside.
Threepeater_Description:
<color=#11037A>Threepeater shoots peas in three lanes at once.</color>

Threepeater likes reading, chess and long periods of immobility in the park. Threepeater enjoys going to shows, particularly modern jazz. “I'm just looking for that special someone,” he says. Threepeater's favorite number is 5.
TangleKelp_Description:
<color=#11037A>Tangle Kelp is an aquatic plant that pulls approaching zombies underwater.</color>

“I'm totally invisible,” Tangle Kelp thinks to himself. “I'll hide here just below the surface. Nobody will see me.” His friends tell him they can see him perfectly well, but Tangle Kelp doesn't seem to want to change his mind.
Jalapeno_Description:
<color=#11037A>Jalapeno destroys an entire lane of zombies.</color>

“NNNNNGGGGG!!!!!!!!” Jalapeno says. He's not going to explode, not this time. But soon. Oh, so soon. It's close. He knows it, he can feel it, his whole life's been leading up to this moment.
Spikeweed_Description:
<color=#11037A>Spikeweed pops tires and hurts any zombies that step on it.</color>

Spikeweed is obsessed with hockey. He's got box seat season tickets. He keeps close track of his favorite players. And he consistently cleans up in the office hockey pool. Just one problem: he's terrified of pucks.
Torchwood_Description:
<color=#11037A>Peas that pass through Torchwood turn into fireballs that deal twice as much damage.</color>

Everybody likes and respects Torchwood. They like him for his integrity, for his steadfast friendship, for his ability to greatly maximize pea damage. But Torchwood has a secret: he can't read.
SeaShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Sea-shroom is an aquatic plant that shoots short-ranged spores.</color>

Sea-shroom has never seen the sea. It's in his name, he's heard loads about it, but he's just never found the time. One day, though... yes, he'll see the sea.
Plantern_Description:
<color=#11037A>Plantern lights up an area, letting you see through the fog.</color>

Plantern defies science. He just does. Other plants eat light and excrete oxygen; Plantern eats darkness and excretes light. Plantern's cagey about how he does it. “I'm not gonna say ‘sorcery,’ I wouldn't use the term ‘dark forces,’ I just... I think I've said enough.”
Cactus_Description:
<color=#11037A>Cactus shoots spikes that hit both ground and air targets.</color>

Sure, Cactus is prickly, but beneath the spikes is a gentle heart full of love and kindness. She just wants to hug and be hugged. Most folks can't hang with that, but Cactus doesn't mind. She's had her eye on an armadillo for a while, and this time it might really work out.
Blover_Description:
<color=#11037A>Blover blows away all balloon zombies and can also blow away fog.</color>

When Blover was five, he got a shiny birthday cake. Blover made his wish, huffed and puffed, but was only able to blow out 60% of the candles. Instead of giving up, though, he used that early defeat as motivation to push himself harder ever since.
SplitPea_Description:
<color=#11037A>Split Pea shoots peas forward and backward.</color>

“Yeah, I'm a Gemini,” says Split Pea. “I know, big surprise. But having two heads — or really, one head with a large head-like growth on the back — pays off big in my line of work.”
Starfruit_Description:
<color=#11037A>Starfruit shoots stars in 5 directions.</color>

“Aw, man,” says Starfruit. “I went to the dentist the other day and he said that I have four cavities. I've got, like, ONE tooth! Four cavities in one tooth? How does this happen?”
Pumpkin_Description:
<color=#11037A>Pumpkin protects other plants with its tough shell.</color>

Pumpkin hasn't heard from his cousin Renfield lately. Apparently Renfield's a big star, some kind of... what was it... sports hero? Peggle Master? Pumpkin doesn't really get it. He just does his job.
MagnetShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Magnet-shroom pulls helmets and other metal objects off zombies.</color>

Magnetism is a powerful force. Very powerful. Sometimes it scares Magnet-shroom a little. With great power comes great responsibility, and he's not sure he's up to it.
CabbagePult_Description:
<color=#11037A>Cabbage-pult lobs cabbages at zombies.</color>

Cabbage-pult is okay with launching cabbages at zombies. It's what he's paid to do, after all, and he's good at it. He just doesn't understand how the zombies get up on the roof in the first place.
FlowerPot_Description:
<color=#11037A>Flower Pot lets you plant on the roof.</color>

“I'm a pot for planting. Yet I'm also a plant. HAS YOUR MIND EXPLODED YET?”
KernelPult_Description:
<color=#11037A>Kernel-pult flings kernels and butter at zombies.</color>

Kernel-pult is the eldest of the Pult brothers. Of the three of them, Kernel-pult is the only one who remembers the others' birthdays — though he usually gets the dates a little wrong.
InstantCoffee_Description:
<color=#11037A>Coffee Bean wakes up sleeping mushrooms.</color>

Coffee Bean: “Hey, guys! Hey, what's going on? Who is that? Hey! You see that thing? What thing? Whoa! Lions!” Yep, Coffee Bean sure knows how to get himself excited.
Garlic_Description:
<color=#11037A>Garlic makes zombies change lanes.</color>

Lane-diversion isn't just Garlic's profession. It's his passion. He carries an advanced Doctorate in Redirection from the Brussels University. He'll talk lane vectors and repulse arrays all day. He even pushes things into the street at home. Somehow his wife puts up with it.
UmbrellaLeaf_Description:
<color=#11037A>Umbrella Leaf protects nearby plants from Bungee Zombies and Catapult Zombies.</color>

Umbrella Leaf: “THWOOMP! You like that? I can do it again. THWOOMP! Ooh yeah, I just flex my leaves upward real fast to protect my neighbors. Yeah. That's how I roll. Yeah, believe it.”
Marigold_Description:
<color=#11037A>Marigold gives you silver and gold coins.</color>

Marigold spends a good deal of time deciding whether to spit out a silver coin or a gold coin. She weighs it from every angle, thinks hard, and does exhaustive research. She keeps up on the latest publications. That's how successful people stay ahead.
MelonPult_Description:
<color=#11037A>Melon-pult does heavy damage to groups of zombies.</color>

Subtlety was never Melon-pult's style. “Sun... gives... me... STRENGTH! I'm the hardest-hitting plant on this lawn,” he says. “I'm not bragging. Look at the stats and you'll see.”
GatlingPea_Description:
<color=#11037A>Gatling Pea shoots four peas at a time.</color>

When Gatling Pea announced he was joining the military, his parents were worried. They said in unison, “Honey, it's just so dangerous.” Gatling Pea refused to budge. “Life is dangerous,” he replied, eyes glinting with steely conviction.
GloomShroom_Description:
<color=#11037A>Gloom-shroom releases heavy fumes all around itself.</color>

“I love to release heavy fumes,” says Gloom-shroom. “I know a lot of people aren't into that. They say it's rude and it smells bad. All I can say is, would you rather have your brains eaten by zombies?”
Cattail_Description:
<color=#11037A>Attacks zombies in any lane, and balloon zombies too.</color>

“Woof!” says Cattail. “Woof! Woof! Woof! Does this confuse you? Do you expect me to say ‘Meow!’ just because ‘cat’ is in my name and I look like a cat? That's not how things work around here. I refuse to be pigeonholed.”
WinterMelon_Description:
<color=#11037A>Winter Melon does area damage and slows zombies.</color>

Winter Melon tries to calm his nerves. He hears the zombies approach. Will he make it? Will anyone make it?
GoldMagnet_Description:
<color=#11037A>Gold Magnet collects coins and diamonds for you.</color>

“How did I end up here?” asks Gold Magnet. “I was on the fast track — corner office, full benefits, stock options. I was a vice president! And now? I'm out here on this beat-up lawn, worried about getting eaten by zombies! Oh, wait — a coin!”
Spikerock_Description:
<color=#11037A>Spikerock pops multiple tires and damages zombies that walk over it.</color>

Spikerock just got back from a trip to Europe. He had a great time, met some wonderful people, really broadened his horizons. He never knew they made museums so big, or put so many paintings in them. That was a big surprise for him.
CobCannon_Description:
<color=#11037A>Click Cob Cannon to launch a deadly corn cob.</color>

What's the deal with Cob Cannon? He went to Harvard. He worked at a top New York law firm. He takes out huge groups of zombies with a single blast. Everybody knows that. But dig deeper — what really drives him?
Imitater_Description:
<color=#11037A>Imitater lets you use two copies of the same plant in one level!</color>

“I remember the zombie war of '76,” says Imitater in a raspy voice. “Back then we didn't have fancy fellas like Peashooter or Jalapeno. All we had was guts and a little shovel! Oh, and by the way — I'm actually a potato.”
ExplodeONut_Description:
<color=#11037A>Explodes when it touches a zombie.</color>

Explode-o-nut often brags about how tough it is, and is often disappointed, because whenever it invites people to hit it and test its toughness, they back away. “I don't know why people are afraid to touch me. Do they think I'll break? Or that they won't let me sacrifice myself?” What it'll never realize is that it's never the only one who gets sacrificed.
GiantWallnut_Description:
<color=#11037A>Giant Wall-nut rolls forward and knocks down every zombie it hits.</color>

“I'm unstoppable on the battlefield — my friends all look up to my mighty frame!” says Giant Wall-nut proudly. “A year after getting kicked out of the Wall-nut Bowling Club, I finally found the job that's right for me.”
Sprout_Description:
<color=#11037A>The origin of every plant in the garden.</color>

“Old.”
LeftPeater_Description:
<color=#11037A>Fires peas in the opposite direction.</color>

“Did anyone ask?”
NuclearMushroom_Description:
<color=#ff0000>(No description yet)</color>

<color=#11037A>“In the Trash Edition you called me a dud, and I let it slide. But here — what should you be calling me?”</color>
Angel_Description:
<color=#11037A>When you blink, it teleports or instantly kills a plant and fully heals. Reveals its true form when it gets close.</color>

The Angel Statue was once a decoration in the graveyard of an abandoned church — until Dr. Zomboss passed by, was deeply moved by ‘her serene and holy aura’, and decided to move her into Z Corp as the company's treasure. While moving her, his porters noticed something strange: whenever everyone looked away, she seemed to shift position slightly. The Engineer Zombie declared on the spot: ‘It's an illusion. We've been hauling stuff all day, our eyes are tired.’ Then he yawned and closed his eyes for a moment — and when he opened them, the statue was gone, and all that was left in front of him was a pile of rubble. The Engineer Zombie quit that day and became an electrical engineer instead. The doctor later wrote in his lab report: ‘Conclusion: the Angel Statue is extremely sensitive to being watched. All soldiers are advised to keep their eyes open in battle — until their eyes dry out.’ The first time the Ghost Bride saw the Angel Statue, she floated silently in front of it for a long time. Then she turned to Paperman and said: ‘She's more of a work of art than I am.’ Paperman replied: ‘She is a work of art. You're a ghost.’ After a moment of silence, the Ghost Bride said: ‘I can be a work of art too.’ Then she tore a strip of red silk from her wedding dress and draped it over the statue's head: ‘A holy red veil. Perfect.’ The Angel Statue didn't teleport — maybe she thought the red veil looked nice on her. Friendly reminder: if your eyes start to sting, you're already playing a game with her that you're destined to lose.
RottenMeat_Description:
<color=#11037A>Speeds up when hurt, and explodes and splits when it dies. Finishing it with an explosion or freeze stops it from splitting.</color>

“Rotten to the core.”
MiniRottenMeat_Description:
<color=#11037A>Still explodes in a small area when it dies, but doesn't split any further.</color>

“A little girl playing with Wall-nuts, Peashooters and other plants, such a sweet and harmonious scene, with such soothing music. What are you all so scared of?”
Paladin_Zombie_Gargantuar_Description:
<color=#11037A>Summoned by Pastor Garlic.</color>

The Paladin Gargantuar was once Dr. Zomboss's proudest battering ram — until one day he stepped on a Pastor Garlic and got dragged into an entire afternoon of sermons. When he got back up, he felt ‘born again’ — even though on the outside he just looked a little less rusty. His mission now is ‘to defend this lawn with love and violence’, and his holy sword fully supports this. By the way, he prays to the garlic symbol every morning and night, though nobody understands what he's chanting.
Jieming_Description:
<color=#11037A>The first time it falls, it borrows life from a plant and switches to your side. An explosion stops it from borrowing life.</color>

The Life Collector is the least popular ‘elder’ among the eerie ones. She firmly believes that if she lives long enough, she'll eventually see other people's lives come to an end — and then she can ‘borrow’ a little for herself. She doesn't eat plants directly; instead, with her hollow stare and outstretched withered hand, she makes the plants she targets slowly wither and lose years of life. Rumor has it she only joined the eerie army because someone promised to reimburse her for a bowl of hot soup once the lawn is taken.
Witch_Description:
<color=#11037A>She kneels on the ground and cries because her nails are too long to take care of her own bathroom business.</color>

The Witch is a special guest temporarily borrowed from ‘the set next door’. They say she was quietly crying to herself in some city ruins when an eerie recruiter walked by, was ‘deeply moved’ by her wailing song, and signed her on the spot. Everyone's verdict on her: ‘As long as nobody bothers her, she's the quietest decoration on the lawn. But if anyone — even just walking past — looks at her a little too long, she instantly turns into a demolition crew.’ She seems extremely sensitive to any kind of ‘gaze’, whether it's a plant taking aim, a zombie looking back, or Paperman taking one curious glance too many. Friendly reminder: if you hear the crying getting closer, you're already in her ‘line of sight’. Don't look back, don't stop — you might still make it.
Zombie_Clear_Description: <color=#11037A>An ally that fights zombies in melee, fires missiles at intervals, and explodes when it dies.</color>
Woniu_Description: <color=#11037A>Devours plants to heal. It's immune to damage while hiding in its shell; stop firing for 5 seconds to make it come back out.</color>
ZombieKing_Description:
<color=#11037A>Orders zombies to change lanes.</color>

Before becoming one of the eerie, the Overlord Zombie was the most ambitious commander under Dr. Zomboss — though his military talent was nowhere near as big as his voice. He firmly believes he's a ‘tactical genius’, because his battle plans ‘never let zombies line up in one lane and die’. Whenever he sees zombies crowded into the same row, he flies into a rage: ‘Did I tell you to form a queue?! Even when I send you to die, I want it to have some depth!’ So he forces the zombies to spread out into different rows. Unfortunately, his command style has a fatal flaw — he can't tell north from south himself. Sometimes even he can't follow the direction he's pointing. The doctor's assessment of him is spot on: ‘His greatest military achievement is that even the enemy can't figure out what he's trying to do.’
Zombie_Normal_Tip: Speeds up near plants. Basic firepower is enough to handle it.
Pilgrim_Tip: Its armor wears down on its own. Keep up steady damage and it's an easy kill.
Executor_Tip: Turns back after killing a plant, so keep some defense in the back rows too.
Zombie_Polevaulter_Tip: Jumps over the first plant it meets. Use a cheap plant to bait the pole.
Maggot_Tip: Small, but keeps chewing on plants. Clear them fast so nothing slips through.
Zombie_Maggot_Tip: Keeps spawning maggots and leaves three more when it dies. Use area damage first.
Paperman_Tip: Revives after its first death and summons another. Prepare sustained fire to wipe it out completely.
Pseudoman1_Tip: Plants can't hit it while it's disguised. Focus fire after its first attack reveals it.
Pseudoman2_Tip: Plants can't hit it while it's disguised. Focus fire after its first attack reveals it.
Pseudoman3_Tip: Plants can't hit it while it's disguised. Focus fire after its first attack reveals it.
Pseudoman4_Tip: Plants can't hit it while it's disguised. Focus fire after its first attack reveals it.
Pseudoman5_Tip: Plants can't hit it while it's disguised. Focus fire after its first attack reveals it.
Pseudoman6_Tip: Plants can't hit it while it's disguised. Focus fire after its first attack reveals it.
SoulStirring_Tip: Its shockwave terrifies and silences plants in front of it for 20 seconds. Meat Grinder is unaffected.
Taller_Tip: Normal straight shots can't hit it. Use lobbers, explosions or area damage.
Qitao_Tip: When it reaches a plant, click it within 5 seconds and pay 100 coins, or it carries the plant away.
Survivor_Zombie_Tip: This is an ally. It won't attack plants and only fights enemy zombies.
Zombie_scarecrow_Tip: Big single hits release crows. Use steady, small continuous damage instead.
Crow_Tip: Fast and eats plants quickly. Use instant damage on it first.
HangedCorpse_Tip: Drops in front of a tile with a plant and silences it. Protect your key plants.
CarPaperman_Tip: Runs over everything in its path and summons the Ghost Bride. Focus fire as soon as it appears.
Siren_Tip: Stops for 25 seconds while sounding its siren and calls three zombie waves. Use that time to focus fire on it.
Witch_Tip: Starts crying after entering column 8, and only gets angry and attacks once her health drops below 470.
C2Zombie_Tip: Normal damage only makes it grow more heads. Only ash damage can destroy it.
Terrorist1_Tip: Kill No. 1 first to take out the bound No. 2 with it before they can work together.
Terrorist2_Tip: Releases a sickle at tile 8 that keeps advancing and pushing plants. Deal with it early.
PVZ_Normal_Tip: The classic regular zombie. No special abilities.
PVZ_Cone_Tip: The cone gives extra protection, so it takes more firepower.
PVZ_Bucket_Tip: The bucket is very tough. Use high damage or crowd control first.
LungZombie_Tip: Passes straight through plants. Hit it with lobbers, explosions, area damage or status effects.
Zombie_Cone_Tip: Its armor wears down on its own. Keep up steady damage and it's an easy kill.
Zombie_Bucket_Tip: Turns back after killing a plant, so keep some defense in the back rows too.
Zombie_Scarecrow_Tip: Big single hits release crows. Use steady, small continuous damage instead.
Bride_Tip: Blinks around and throws handkerchiefs along her row. Don't bunch up your key plants.
Angel_Tip: When you blink, it teleports or instantly kills a plant and fully heals. When it gets angry, that's your window to focus fire.
RottenMeat_Tip: Speeds up when hurt, and explodes and splits on death. Finish it with an explosion or freeze to stop the split.
MiniRottenMeat_Tip: Still explodes in a small area on death but doesn't split. Don't let it reach your plant groups.
Paladin_Zombie_Gargantuar_Tip: This is an ally that smashes zombies. It takes only a quarter damage from everything except bites and explosions.
Jieming_Tip: The first time it falls, it borrows life from a plant and becomes an ally. Explosions stop it from borrowing life.
Zombie_Clear_Tip: This is an ally. It fights zombies in melee, fires missiles at intervals, and explodes when it dies.
Woniu_Tip: Devours plants to heal. Immune while in its shell; stop firing for 5 seconds to force it back out.
dave_Level1_Tip: Crushes the tile where it appears, and randomly poisons, pulls in or smashes plants.
DaveBone_Tip: Can only be damaged while emerging from the ground. Then it burrows and strikes a random plant and the two tiles in front of it.
dave_eye_Tip: Roams the whole lawn and blasts the three tiles in front of it with a laser every 5 seconds.
dave_heart_Tip: Bounces around the lawn and fires a ring of 24 gut projectiles every 7 seconds.
ZombieKing_Tip: Orders other zombies to switch rows every 10 seconds. Adjust each row's defense in time.
处刑者_Description:
<color=#11037A>The Executioner turns around after killing a plant, walks back to the map edge, then returns. It still attacks plants along the way; if it kills another plant while turned around, it immediately turns again.</color>

HP:<color=#FF0000>270 base, 1100 bucket armor</color>
